text_blocks.snippet: COVID-19 vaccines, particularly mRNA vaccines, have been associated with a rare risk of myocarditis (inflammation of the heart muscle) and pericarditis (inflammation of the lining outside the heart). While the risk is low, it is more common in males, especially young men, and is more likely after the second dose. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention | CDC (.gov) emphasizes that the benefits of vaccination in preventing severe COVID-19 illness far outweigh the risk of these rare heart conditions.
